concerns.text: The JSON‑Schema for `data/processed/user_track_pairs_thr{n}.parquet` sets `total_listens` minimum to 3, but FR‑009 (and the specification) require filtering out rows with `total_listens < 5`. This mismatch will cause schema validation failures and violates the functional requirement. Adjust the schema minimum to 5 (or remove the minimum constraint) to align with the spec.
